findings: The pinned 0.8.11 C toolchain supplies MinGW headers and runtimes for Windows and has no native MSVC SDK composition. Rust direct-linker patches alone cannot supply missing SDK libraries.
Release 0.8.24 documents native MSVC ABI toolchains using clang-cl, lld-link, the Microsoft runtime, and Windows SDK; it depends on windows_support 0.4.1.
Upstream issue 811 identifies the missing legacy_stdio_definitions.lib runtime allowlist entry required by Rust libc.
A version upgrade also requires rebasing the existing custom V8 C++ header and MinGW compatibility patches; dry-run checks do not apply cleanly.
next_steps: Review the candidate LLVM/windows_support patches and expanded dependency graph.
Run MSVC executable validation after explicit Microsoft license acceptance, then revalidate all currently passing target builds before a production upgrade.
